scope: Preserve every generation-13 direct-user unit exactly (62/62) and append three 2026-10-03 direct user refinements of the ZFC-circle route. The first proposes a meta-theory/sub-theory account: ZFC as a foundational logical framework and the dense-number-line limit theory as a subtheory may both omit a time/computability dimension; the circle process makes that omission observable by forcing examination of whether a limit treatment of Zeno has legitimately completed the original process. The second proposes the already identified HoTT Q as a controlled test of whether ZFC-level foundations leave that process-completion question unexamined. The third refines the prospective verdict from absence to incompleteness: ZFC may have temporal observation resources while lacking a complete process-completion observation. These are included as user-directed mathematical-philosophical research hypotheses and continuing-method consciousness. They do not establish that ZFC cannot encode time, that ZFC is formally inconsistent, that any limit theorem is false, that H0 has transported to Z0, or that a ZFC Q has been located.

message_decisions.reason: 用户直接细化了 ZFC—连续统—圆环路线的长期研究意识：以基础框架和子理论的关系说明为何静态极限回答可能漏掉过程完成的时间／可计算性边界，并将圆环作为强制检查该 bridge 的过程。该消息改变未来候选的解释边界和 P3-C 的验收视角，属于核心方法论；它保留为用户研究假设，不成为 ZFC 表达能力负结论、数学定理、物理事实或 ZFC 命中。
用户进一步提出：既有 HoTT 的不合理 Q 可作为检验 ZFC 元理论精度的证据，若 ZFC 放过 HoTT 的该 Q，便可能暴露其对时间／过程完成边界缺少批判力。该原话改变了未来 H0→Z0 路线的研究优先级与 MetaPrecisionCard 的控制设计；它仍不允许由 HoTT Q、ZFC 模型、形式化或一般兼容性直接推出 Z0、ZFC Q 或 ZFC 的形式不一致。
用户将潜在终局判词精确为“ZFC 在时间维度上的理论观察力不完备”：承认 ZFC 有时间／阶段／轨迹等观察资源，同时把研究焦点放在其是否缺少对过程完成、同一任务 bridge 和 Done 的完备观察。该原话防止把候选误报为‘没有时间维度’或形式矛盾，并为受控来源审计规定更精确的最终语言。
